en:
Could it be...that the additional arrows
were brought in by a <CLT=cltSTRONG>third party<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

A third party? So someone 
besides Kokichi or Himiko?

That's just a guess, though. There's no way
a third party exists.

If a third party did exist, why would 
they bring two arrows?

Kaito was the only one with a crossbow. 
I made sure I handed it to him...

Kaito said he only needed one arrow.
Clearly, he didn't want a fight.
So, the other two arrows weren't for Kaito...

they were for the <CLT=cltSTRONG>third party<CLT=cltNORMAL>
to use themselves.

So, the third party didn't hand the arrows
through the window...

Instead, they went into the hangar and
shot the crossbow themselves?

Impossible. There was an alarm system and
an electric barrier around the hangar.

Yeah. That hangar should've been
completely closed off, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>It was completely closed off?
But can we confirm that?

<CLT=cltMIND>I feel like there might be another way.
Some way that we haven't figured out yet.

<CLT=cltMIND>What method did the third party
use to enter the hangar?
